title: Pharmacist prescribing of hormonal contraception
rule_summary: A Massachusetts pharmacist may prescribe and dispense eligible hormonal contraceptive patches and self-administered oral products after the required screening and under the official protocol and labeling.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply hormonal contraception requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing hormonal contraception with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
